decodeImage.description:
the scan line period and the pixel clock are measured from the waveform data
itself (see the ``decode.report`` function), the legacy ``windowSize`` and
``offset`` parameters of the decoder are not used any more.

parameters.name: start
parameters.text: the data start position on the raw wav file

parameters.name: wavFile
parameters.text: the file path of the wav file

parameters.name: size
parameters.text: the pixel cells (the image rows) inside a single scan line, default 364

parameters.name: lines
parameters.text: the number of the scan lines (the image columns), default 512

parameters.name: white
parameters.text: the white point gain of the rendering, 1 means no adjustment

parameters.name: gamma
parameters.text: the gamma correction of the rendering, 1 means no correction

parameters.name: percentile
parameters.text: the black point and the white point percentiles of the auto levels

parameters.name: palette
parameters.text: the palette name of the pseudo color rendering

parameters.name: smooth
parameters.text:
the radius of the across scan line smoothing, 0 for disable.
the smoothing is disabled by default because it reduces the edge
contrast of the decoded image and makes it look blurred

parameters.name: luminous
parameters.text: render the image as the pseudo color image

parameters.name: report
parameters.text: print the empirical analysis report of the data section

decodeImage.title: Decode a grayscale image on the disk
